player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id} long SimpleTak.
Long borad, ston bilong yu i kamap olsem '{player_stone}' na ston bilong opisit bilong yu i kamap olsem '{opponent_stone}'.

Long tahn bilong yu, yu chusim wanpela sel we i empty (olsem nem bilong index) na putim ston bilong yu long hap.
Olsem, '[12]' putim ston bilong yu long sel 12.

Objektiv bilong yu em i mekim wok bilong ston bilong yu ol i kamap wanpela path we i go long tu edis opisit bilong borad (top-to-bottom o left-to-right).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: I no orait long format bilong move (long PNG)
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Sel {cell_num} i no inap. Mas beklong 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Sel {cell_num} i stap pinis. Makim wanpela sel em nogat man long en.

action.placement: Pleya {current_player_id} putim simbol bilong em ({symbol}) long sel {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: Ol i pulap pinis long bodi bilong em. Em draw!
